meta.title: OHLCV Data Fetching & Multi-Timeframe Support
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Implement OHLCV candlestick data fetching from Lighter.xyz for multiple timeframes to enable historical data ingestion for backtesting.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: OHLCV data fetched via GET /candlesticks, parsed into Polars DataFrame
Date range handling works (start_date, end_date respected)
Pagination handled for large date ranges

key-tasks.task: Implement fetch() async method with symbols, dates, resolution
Implement date range handling with timezone conversion

architecture-context.pattern: Follow existing data adapter fetch patterns. Return Polars DataFrame.
architecture-context.constraint: 1 year of daily data in less than 30 seconds (NFR6)

technical-specifications.spec: async def fetch( self, symbols: list[str], start_date: pd.Timestamp, end_date: pd.Timestamp, resolution: str, ) -> pl.DataFrame: lighter_resolution = self._map_resolution(resolution) all_data = [] for symbol in symbols: symbol_data = await self._fetch_symbol(symbol, start_date, end_date, lighter_resolution) all_data.append(symbol_data) return pl.concat(all_data) if all_data else self._empty_dataframe()

async def _fetch_symbol(self, symbol, start_date, end_date, resolution): all_candles = [] current_start = start_date while current_start < end_date: params = { "symbol": symbol, "resolution": resolution, "from": int(current_start.timestamp()), "to": int(end_date.timestamp()), "limit": 1000, } response = await self._client.get("/candlesticks", params=params) candles = response.json().get("candles", []) if not candles: break all_candles.extend(candles) last_timestamp = candles[-1]["timestamp"] current_start = pd.Timestamp(last_timestamp, unit='s') + pd.Timedelta(seconds=1) return self._parse_candles(all_candles, symbol)

nfr-references.nfr: 1 year daily data in less than 30 seconds
